menu.name: Greek Salad
menu.description: Our delicious salad is served with Feta cheese and peeled cucumber. Includes tomatoes, onions, olives, salt and oregano in the ingredients.

menu.name: Bruschetta
menu.description: Delicious grilled bread rubbed with garlic and topped with olive oil and salt. Our Bruschetta includes tomato and cheese.

menu.name: Grilled Fish
menu.description: Whole fish grilled over charcoal with sea salt and lemon, served with potatoes and a fresh salad.

menu.name: Pasta
menu.description: Penne tossed in a rich tomato sauce with garlic, olive oil and fresh basil.

menu.name: Lemon Dessert
menu.description: A zesty lemon tart topped with fresh berries and mint.

menu.name: Fava Dip & Warm Pita
menu.description: Creamy Santorini-style fava (puréed yellow split peas) with olive oil and herbs, served with warm sesame pita.

menu.name: Dolmades
menu.description: Tender vine leaves filled with lemony rice and fresh herbs.

menu.name: Saganaki
menu.description: Pan-fried Greek cheese with a squeeze of lemon and a drizzle of honey.

menu.name: Lamb Souvlaki
menu.description: Charcoal-grilled lamb skewers with tzatziki and warm pita.

menu.name: Gigantes Plaka
menu.description: Giant beans baked in a rich tomato and herb sauce, served with crusty bread.

menu.name: Lemon Herb Chicken
menu.description: Roasted chicken marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, with potatoes.

menu.name: Mushroom Risotto
menu.description: Creamy risotto with wild mushrooms, parmesan and fresh thyme.

menu.name: Honey & Nut Yogurt
menu.description: Thick Greek yogurt topped with toasted hazelnuts and a drizzle of honey syrup.

menu.name: Chocolate Mousse Cake
menu.description: Silky chocolate mousse on a crunchy cocoa crumb base, dusted with cocoa.

menu.name: Fresh Lemonade
menu.description: Hand-squeezed lemons, a touch of sugar and plenty of ice.

menu.name: Peach Iced Tea
menu.description: Black tea chilled with ripe peach and a hint of lemon.

menu.name: Sparkling Limonata
menu.description: Italian-style sparkling lemon soda over ice, with a lemon wedge and a sprig of rosemary.

menu.name: Cappuccino
menu.description: Rich espresso with steamed milk and a velvety foam.
